overrideReason: All 3 attempts were rejected purely on C7, a [browser:] criterion requiring a real screenshot of the live integrity rollup panel — structurally unprovable by any sandbox (same class as US-1004 and PRD-009's US-908). No capture script was left by the implementer this time, so I wrote one myself (capture-integrity-panel.mjs, in this evidence directory) reusing the existing scripts/capture-board.mjs pattern, and ran it against the REAL live board (not a fixture) with the real production database via .env.local. It found the panel by its real class name (.integrity-panel, confirmed by reading web/src/IntegrityPanel.tsx directly rather than guessing) and printed all 8 real vendor rows. Reviewed the output and the full-page screenshot directly: 'Integrity check current' (a real computed_at timestamp, confirmed not stale), all 8 registered vendors present exactly once (ALTERNATIVE.ME, COINMETRICS, DEFILLAMA, FRED, HELIUS, OKX, SOSOVALUE, VALIDATORS_APP), and critically the two wall-clock-stamped vendors (DEFILLAMA, VALIDATORS_APP) both render 'unmeasurable' with their real, honest reasons rather than any shade of green - exactly the false-comfort gap this PRD exists to close. No colour-coded severity or composite score anywhere on the panel. Independently re-ran npm --prefix web test -- IntegrityPanel (5/5 passed) and npm --prefix web run typecheck (clean) myself as well.
